operations.mkdir: std::fs::DirBuilder with Unix mode -> libc::mkdir, cvt

source_evidence: Pinned rust-src library/std/src/sys/fs/unix.rs: DirBuilder::mkdir/set_mode, unlink, rename, rmdir. Each uses the corresponding native call without the cvt_r EINTR retry loop.
compatibility: Existing CString conversion truncates at the first NUL before converting its bytes to a borrowed Unix OsStr/Path.
Errors use the returned io::Error raw OS code, not a later read of errno.
DirBuilderExt::mode narrows u32 to mode_t in the pinned implementation, as the old wrapper did.
No public signature, trait bound, dependency or version change.
excluded_operation: chmod remains unchanged: pinned std set_perm uses cvt_r and retries EINTR, whereas the existing wrapper reports the first error.
